request.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn the plesiosaur into a chunky cute narwhal swimming at the surface: a fat round whale body, no long neck, one long straight spiral pale ivory tusk pointing forward from its head, small flippers and a tail fluke; warm cream-white skin with dark brown-grey spots on its back; a small Ice Folk rider in a dark brown-grey fur parka with a cream fur hood sits on its back holding a bone spear with an ice-blue tip. Keep the size, waterline, thick black outline and style, nothing under the body.
